spans.s:
मोघ a. [मह्-घ अच् वा कुत्वं]
1
Vain, useless, fruitless, unprofitable,
unsuccessful; याच्ञा मोया वरमधिगु
णे नाधेमे लब्धकामा

.
--2 A imless, purposeless,
indefinite.
--3 Left, abandoned
--4
Idle.
--घः A fence, an enclosure, a
hedge.
--घा The trumpet flower
--घं ind. In vain, to no purpose,
uselessly.
--Comp.
--कर्मन् a.
engaging in useless rites.
--पुष्पा a barren
woman.

मोघीकृ {c8c} U. To render useless,
frustrate.
